How well you play defines how much XP you earn, and the more accurately you tap to the beat, the more XP you'll receive! XP is used for purchasing new tracks and features, so you want to follow the cues and tap consecutively to create lines and get bonus combo XP! As you progress, you'll unlock new songs that will put your rhythm and mixing skills to the test as the challenge ramps up! 

Tap & Mix also allows you to create and perform original mixes in 'Free Mix' mode. Free Mix takes you to a set of virtual decks, where you can add songs and start mixing independently straight away! You'll have access to a range of professional DJing tools that will allow you to manipulate your tracks as you practice and perform amazing mixes. As you explore your condensed CDJ setup, you’ll be able to sync BPM, manipulate tracks with professional studio FX, and experiment with EQ and faders. Further to this, you'll be able to scratch the decks as you perform your tracks live! Free Mix is for users of all levels as it’s designed for ease of use, allowing you to practice authentic Djing in an entirely accessible format.

Tap & Mix is a DJ game that doesn't drop a beat! Step up to the decks and start tapping to the beat and mixing your tracks now. It's time for Tap & Mix.
